newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currency futures end off, but yen higher.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currency futures end off, but yen higher.

text.p: Aug 1 - Most IMM currencies ended moderately lower, but yen was higher. Sept marks and Swiss end near contract lows. One commission house sold 1,000 Sept yen on the close, a French bank affiliate sold 2,500 marks late, traders said. Good volume noted in marks, at 40,000 contracts. Other currencies more quiet, traders said. Strong dollar sentiment continues, they said.
